name: design-ops-64
prompt: The attached images are STYLE references only (classic Korean MMORPG pixel art). For more of that style, browse these two games and study their character sprites: 바람의나라: 연 https://baramy.nexon.com/ and 도깨비의세계 https://dokkaebi.kakaogames.com/preregister/ . Learn from them: thick 1px dark outlines, dithered shading, saturated but limited palette, about 3 to 3.5 heads tall with a large head and voluminous hair, slight 3/4 top-down view, light coming from the upper left. Then draw a NEW original character (not a copy of any reference): a 28-year-old Australian woman, the design studio's assistant designer and keeper of the sprite warehouse, in Joseon-fantasy attire - sun-bleached blonde hair (#d8b25c) in one long braid down her back tied with a red ribbon (댕기), fair skin, two clearly visible dark eyes, a practical no-nonsense expression. Clothing: a short white jeogori jacket (#f4efe4) over a long full skirt in burnt orange (#c96f3b), white shoes. A small ring of brass keys hangs at her waist on her right hip, and she holds a wooden measuring ruler (자) upright in her right hand. Requirements: one character, full body, idle standing pose, facing the viewer (south), centered on a flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF), no drop shadow, no text, no border, no scenery. Render as crisp pixel art about 64 pixels tall (head to feet), then upscale exactly 8x with nearest-neighbor so every logical pixel is a sharp 8x8 block on a 512x512 canvas, and give me that PNG to download.
note: 하네스가 시트 절을 64px 정지 그림 절로 바꿈 (대표 결정 2026-09-12)
